ModMetaData.name: Show Me Your Tools - Forked
ModMetaData.author: astryl
ModMetaData.description:
[b]Forked with permission from Meathax[/b]
[i]Performance optimizations for uncached / uncalled Harmony patches[/i].
Show Me Your Tools overhauls how colonist work looks. Every job draws an animated hand tool over the worker — pickaxe, axe, welder, cleaver, sickle, broom, sewing needle, surgeon's saw and dozens more — each with its own swing, hit-synced strike sounds, and material-aware debris (wood chips, stone shards, welding sparks, soil clods, sawdust). Tools rest at the hip when idle, hands grip the haft (with optional forearms) via Show Me Your Hands, and particle effects recolor with the season and the worked material.
Lots of human touches: brow wipes on hard labor, a pickaxe that jams in the rock, a researcher scratching their head over an idea, a cook stirring the pot, sparks showering off a weld bead.
Highly configurable — toggle tools and effects individually, tune particle intensity and debris size, or turn the whole thing off per tool. Soft-compatible with Yayo's Animation, Melee Animation, and Medieval Overhaul (adds tool animations to MO's workbenches). Humanlike pawns only. Safe to add or remove mid-save.
